component.name: MakeMKV
component.summary: A decryption and transcoding tool for DVD and Blu-ray discs

description.p: MakeMKV is a toolkit for decrypting and transcoding DVD, HD DVD, and Blu-ray discs to MKV files. It can integrate with libbluray to allow video players (VLC, MPV) to play discs with bus encryption (e.g., Ultra HD Blu-ray).
